items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: We had a swell arranger in that band, too, named Jesse Stone.

ctx.x: He was a trombone player also.

Yeah. Yeah. We had a good arrangement -- good arrangements of Jesse Stone. He really could make some arrangements. You know, he's the one that wrote "Idaho." That's his number, and I think he's got several other numbers. But that "Idaho" is one that became very famous. All the guys used to play that. All the modern guys used to play that.
That's funny -- that's so nice too, nobody plays it anymore.
